info.name: Away
info.plot: Impegnata in una pericolosa missione su Marte alla guida di un equipaggio internazionale, Emma Green deve lasciare il marito e la figlia adolescente.

info.title: Away
info.synopsis: Impegnata in una pericolosa missione su Marte alla guida di un equipaggio internazionale, Emma Green deve lasciare il marito e la figlia adolescente.

seasons.plot: American astronaut Emma Green must leave her husband and teenage daughter behind to command an international space crew embarking upon a treacherous mission. A series about hope, humanity and how we need one another if we are to achieve impossible things.

episodes.name: Go
episodes.plot: Al lancio della missione, la tempra di comandante di Emma è messa alla prova da un incidente a bordo, discordie tra l'equipaggio e un'emergenza di famiglia sulla Terra.

translations.value: Al lancio della missione, la tempra di comandante di Emma è messa alla prova da un incidente a bordo, discordie tra l'equipaggio e un'emergenza di famiglia sulla Terra.

episodes.name: Negative Return
episodes.plot: When a ship malfunction threatens the voyage before it's barely begun, Emma works with a wary Misha on a high-risk repair operation.

translations.value: When a ship malfunction threatens the voyage before it's barely begun, Emma works with a wary Misha on a high-risk repair operation.

episodes.name: Half the Sky
episodes.plot: A staff change at Mission Control upsets the usually unflappable Lu, and the fallout undermines Emma's command. Matt encourages Lex to return to school.

translations.value: A staff change at Mission Control upsets the usually unflappable Lu, and the fallout undermines Emma's command. Matt encourages Lex to return to school.

episodes.name: Excellent Chariots
episodes.plot: Emma puts herself in harm's way when Ram unwittingly endangers the lives of everyone on the Atlas. Matt must make a wrenching decision about his future.

translations.value: Emma puts herself in harm's way when Ram unwittingly endangers the lives of everyone on the Atlas. Matt must make a wrenching decision about his future.

episodes.name: Space Dogs
episodes.plot: As Christmas approaches, the crew prepares to make their final calls home before communication grows spotty. Matt and Lex adjust to their new normal.

translations.value: As Christmas approaches, the crew prepares to make their final calls home before communication grows spotty. Matt and Lex adjust to their new normal.

episodes.name: A Little Faith
episodes.plot: Tempers flare on the Atlas over a water-system glitch and an act of betrayal. As Matt works on the ship's issue, he accidentally meets Lex's new friend.

translations.value: Tempers flare on the Atlas over a water-system glitch and an act of betrayal. As Matt works on the ship's issue, he accidentally meets Lex's new friend.

episodes.name: Goodnight Mars
episodes.plot: Emma's behavior becomes a cause for concern, Kwesi and Lu team up on a plant mystery, and Lex makes an impulsive decision with far-reaching consequences.

translations.value: Emma's behavior becomes a cause for concern, Kwesi and Lu team up on a plant mystery, and Lex makes an impulsive decision with far-reaching consequences.

episodes.name: Vital Signs
episodes.plot: A problem with Atlas' supply ship jeopardizes the mission and sparks questions about Emma's commitment to landing on Mars.

translations.value: A problem with Atlas' supply ship jeopardizes the mission and sparks questions about Emma's commitment to landing on Mars.

episodes.name: Spektr
episodes.plot: Emotions run high as rapidly dwindling water rations on the Atlas leave the crew and Mission Control scrambling to find a fix before time runs out.

translations.value: Emotions run high as rapidly dwindling water rations on the Atlas leave the crew and Mission Control scrambling to find a fix before time runs out.

episodes.name: Home
episodes.plot: With only hours to go before Atlas' planned touchdown on Mars, Emma is confronted with everything that could go wrong, while Lu receives new orders.

translations.value: With only hours to go before Atlas' planned touchdown on Mars, Emma is confronted with everything that could go wrong, while Lu receives new orders.
